payload.title: File:Qianjiangsaurus Size Comparison.svg
payload.description_html:
Size comparison of the holotype specimen (CLGRP V00016) of Qianjiangsaurus changshengi with an adult human male (~1.8 m) for reference.

References

  • "A new late-diverging non-hadrosaurid hadrosauroid (Dinosauria: Ornithopoda) from southwest China: support for interchange of dinosaur faunas across East Asia during the Late Cretaceous"
  • "First report of a hollow cranial crest in an early-diverging duck-billed dinosaur, with implications for convergent evolution of acoustic signaling"
  • "Anatomy and osteohistology of the basal hadrosaurid dinosaur Eotrachodon from the uppermost Santonian (Cretaceous) of southern Appalachia"
  • "An Italian dinosaur Lagerstätte reveals the tempo and mode of hadrosauriform body size evolution"
